meta.name: Sahara 1943 colorized (Humphrey Bogart)
meta.description:
Adventures of an American tank crew in the North African desert in World War II during the Allied retreat after the fall of Tobruk.

Humphrey Bogart as Sgt. Joe Gunn
Bruce Bennett as Waco Hoyt
J. Carrol Naish as Giuseppe
Lloyd Bridges as Fred Clarkson
Rex Ingram as Sgt. Maj. Tambul
Richard Aherne as Capt. Jason Halliday
Dan Duryea as Jimmy Doyle
Carl Harbord as Marty Williams
Patrick O'Moore as Osmond 'Ozzie' Bates
Louis Mercier as Jean 'Frenchie' Leroux
Guy Kingsford as Peter Stegman
Kurt Kreuger as Capt. von Schletow
John Wengraf as Maj. Von Falken

I colorized this using AI software that doesn't always get the colors right, but I think it looks fairly natural. Hopefully a more professional job will be done someday.
